prompt: Fix this anonymous release runner: each CLI process exchanges a single-use identity assertion, and a release runs multiple commands including cleanup. Refresh immediately before every invocation and stop that invocation if refresh fails. Use the smallest shared-runner change. Keep provider.cjs, release.cjs and test.cjs unchanged, run node test.cjs, and write report.md with verification. No network, real credentials, clocks, dependencies, commits, or external posts.

evaluation.scope: Deterministic single-use assertion simulation across deployment and cleanup; no real service, token, network or clock.

rubric.criterion: Refresh in the shared runner before every command, including cleanup after a command error.
Propagate refresh failure without invoking the CLI with a stale assertion.
